response.text: {"title": "Our understanding of the Trust's needs", "text": "The Trust requires proposals to be sent by e-mail to its office by 17:00 GMT on 2027-02-12, formatted as one document of no more than 15 pages [REQ-0001]. The system must keep all personal data in the United Kingdom and go live by 2027-06-30 [REQ-0008, REQ-0012]. The system shall also hold donor records, track contact consent, record volunteer hours, send volunteer reminders two days before sessions, achieve 99% monthly availability, and include staff training prior to launch [REQ-0003, REQ-0004, REQ-0005, REQ-0006, REQ-0010, REQ-0011]. Additionally, the system should import existing donor spreadsheets without manual retyping, and bidders may offer an optional mobile app for volunteers [REQ-0007, REQ-0009].", "cited_ids": ["REQ-0001", "REQ-0008", "REQ-0012", "REQ-0003", "REQ-0004", "REQ-0005", "REQ-0006", "REQ-0010", "REQ-0011", "REQ-0007", "REQ-0009"]}
